entries.en: A high-pitched whistle interrupted the quiet rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一声尖细的口哨打断了安静的排练。

entries.en: The high-profile exhibition brought unexpected crowds to the small gallery.
entries.zh: 那场备受瞩目的展览给小画廊带来了意外的人潮。

entries.en: A high-ranking official attended the opening of the restored theater.
entries.zh: 一位高级官员出席了修复后剧院的开幕式。

entries.en: None of the high-ups had visited our tiny workshop.
entries.zh: 那些高层人物没有一个来过我们的小工坊。

entries.en: The choreographer combined hip-hop with traditional folk rhythms.
entries.zh: 编舞者把嘻哈音乐与传统民间节奏结合起来。

entries.en: She brought home-grown tomatoes to the neighborhood picnic.
entries.zh: 她把自家种的番茄带到了社区野餐上。

entries.en: A home-made kite hung above the children's drawings.
entries.zh: 一个自制风筝挂在孩子们的画上方。

entries.en: The volunteers conducted a house-to-house survey about the park.
entries.zh: 志愿者们就公园问题逐户开展了调查。

entries.en: The diary describes an ill-fated voyage interrupted by repeated storms.
entries.zh: 日记描述了一次屡遭风暴打断的不幸航程。

entries.en: The play mocks a jumped-up official who bullies his former friends.
entries.zh: 这出戏讽刺了一位突然得势、欺负旧友的自大官员。

entries.en: The community hall offered keep-fit on Tuesday evenings.
entries.zh: 社区礼堂每周二晚提供健身活动。

entries.en: The small grant kick-started the theater's community costume project.
entries.zh: 那笔小额资助启动了剧院的社区戏服项目。

entries.en: The delayed delivery had a knock-on effect on the exhibition.
entries.zh: 交货延误对展览产生了连锁影响。

entries.en: The office know-all finally admitted that he needed help.
entries.zh: 办公室里那个自以为什么都懂的人终于承认需要帮助。

entries.en: Our laid-back host seemed unconcerned by the unexpected extra guests.
entries.zh: 随和的主人似乎并不在意意外多来的客人。

entries.en: His laissez-faire approach left artists free to choose their materials.
entries.zh: 他自由放任的做法让艺术家可以自由选择材料。

entries.en: A last-ditch appeal saved the old cinema from closure.
entries.zh: 最后一搏的呼吁挽救了即将关闭的老电影院。

entries.en: The late-night bus carried only three sleepy passengers.
entries.zh: 深夜巴士上只有三位困倦的乘客。

entries.meaningZh: 现代的（指早期类型的后继者）
entries.en: The press hailed the inventor as a latter-day magician.
entries.zh: 媒体把那位发明家称为现代魔术师。

entries.en: The novel's law-abiding clerk is mistaken for a notorious smuggler.
entries.zh: 小说中，一位守法的职员被误认为臭名昭著的走私犯。

entries.en: The left-handed artist kept her brushes on the left.
entries.zh: 那位左撇子画家把画笔放在左侧。

entries.en: He had a short lie-down after carrying the heavy tables.
entries.zh: 搬完沉重的桌子后，他躺下休息了一会儿。

entries.en: Sunday's lie-in ended when the dog began barking at visitors.
entries.zh: 狗开始冲着访客吠叫，星期天的懒觉就此结束了。

entries.en: The report described the injuries as serious but not life-threatening.
entries.zh: 报告称伤势严重，但不危及生命。

entries.en: The museum displays lifesaving equipment from the old coastal station.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一些来自旧海岸站的救生设备。

entries.en: The children counted down to the model rocket's lift-off.
entries.zh: 孩子们为模型火箭升空倒计时。

entries.en: Her light-hearted introduction put the nervous speakers at ease.
entries.zh: 她轻松愉快的开场白让紧张的发言者放松下来。

entries.en: A live link-up allowed the distant choir to join our rehearsal.
entries.zh: 一次实时通信连接让远方合唱团加入了我们的排练。

entries.en: The long-distance coach stopped beside a deserted railway station.
entries.zh: 长途客车停在一座冷清的火车站旁。

entries.en: His long-suffering neighbor returned another football from her garden.
entries.zh: 长期忍耐的邻居又从自家花园里还回一个足球。

entries.en: They chose a low-key celebration with a few close friends.
entries.zh: 他们选择与几位好友低调庆祝。

entries.en: The report describes the experiences of low-paid seasonal workers.
entries.zh: 报告描述了低薪季节工的经历。

entries.en: Ducks gathered around the edge of the man-made lake.
entries.zh: 鸭子聚集在人造湖边。

entries.en: The workshop could not mass-produce such intricate handmade tiles.
entries.zh: 工坊无法大规模生产如此精细的手工瓷砖。

entries.en: Her matter-of-fact account made the unusual event seem ordinary.
entries.zh: 她平静客观的叙述让那件不同寻常的事显得普通。

entries.en: A medium-sized suitcase fitted beneath the worktable.
entries.zh: 一只中等大小的手提箱能放在工作台下面。

entries.en: The club's medium-term plan includes repairing its small rehearsal hall.
entries.zh: 俱乐部的中期计划包括修缮小排练厅。

entries.en: A micro-organism moved across the microscope's field of view.
entries.zh: 一个微生物从显微镜视野中移过。

entries.en: The film places a traditional fairy tale in a modern-day city.
entries.zh: 电影把一个传统童话放进了现代城市。

entries.en: My mother-in-law lent us a set of old gardening tools.
entries.zh: 岳母借给我们一套旧园艺工具。

entries.en: The never-ending queue stretched beyond the station entrance.
entries.zh: 仿佛永无尽头的队伍延伸到了车站入口外。

entries.en: At night-time, the empty station became a quiet shelter for bats.
entries.zh: 夜间，空车站成了蝙蝠安静的栖身处。

entries.en: Her no-nonsense advice helped us finish the complicated set.
entries.zh: 她务实的建议帮助我们完成了复杂的布景。

entries.en: The historian compared the policies of several non-aligned states.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了几个不结盟国家的政策。

entries.en: The advertisement promised a non-existent view of the sea.
entries.zh: 广告许诺了一处根本不存在的海景。

entries.en: The seminar compared historical approaches to nuclear non-proliferation.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了历史上防止核扩散的不同做法。

entries.en: As a non-smoker, she disliked the smell of old tobacco.
entries.zh: 她不吸烟，不喜欢陈烟的味道。

entries.en: The non-stick pan was lighter than our old iron skillet.
entries.zh: 不粘锅比我们的旧铁煎锅轻。

entries.en: The archive preserves photographs of the non-violent demonstration.
entries.zh: 档案保存着那次非暴力示威的照片。

entries.en: The archive preserves interviews with non-white residents of the city.
entries.zh: 档案保存着对该城非白人居民的访谈。

entries.en: The odds-on favorite lost to an unknown newcomer.
entries.zh: 大受看好的夺冠热门输给了一位无名新人。

entries.en: The sudden turn left the dancer off-balance for a moment.
entries.zh: 突然转身让舞者一时失去了平衡。

entries.en: Her off-the-wall costume ideas delighted the amateur theater group.
entries.zh: 她古怪别致的戏服点子让业余剧团很高兴。

entries.en: An old-style cash register sat beside the modern tablet.
entries.zh: 一台旧式收银机放在现代平板电脑旁。

entries.en: The band played old-time dance tunes on fiddle and banjo.
entries.zh: 乐队用小提琴和班卓琴演奏旧时风格的舞曲。

entries.en: The on-screen instructions vanished before I finished reading them.
entries.zh: 我还没读完，屏幕上的说明就消失了。

entries.en: His one-man show filled the little theater for a week.
entries.zh: 他的独角戏让小剧院连续一周满座。

entries.en: A blue one-piece swimsuit hung beside the pool's changing room.
entries.zh: 泳池更衣室旁挂着一件蓝色连体泳衣。

entries.en: The one-sided account ignored the volunteers' contribution to the project.
entries.zh: 这份片面的叙述忽视了志愿者对项目的贡献。

entries.en: The tutor offered one-to-one sessions after the group workshop.
entries.zh: 集体工作坊后，导师提供了一对一辅导。

entries.en: The delivery van entered a narrow one-way street.
entries.zh: 送货车驶入一条狭窄的单行道。

entries.en: The open-air concert ended beneath a sky full of stars.
entries.zh: 露天音乐会在满天星斗下结束。

entries.en: The director's open-door policy encouraged staff to raise concerns.
entries.zh: 主任随时欢迎来访的政策鼓励员工提出顾虑。

entries.en: The open-ended question produced answers nobody had expected.
entries.zh: 这道开放式问题引出了没人预料到的回答。

entries.en: An open-minded audience welcomed the unfamiliar blend of musical styles.
entries.zh: 思想开放的观众欢迎这种不熟悉的音乐风格融合。

entries.en: The form includes an opt-out for future reminder emails.
entries.zh: 表格设有不接收后续提醒邮件的选项。

entries.en: Only paid-up members received the club's commemorative booklet.
entries.zh: 只有缴清会费的会员收到了俱乐部纪念册。

entries.en: A passer-by helped us carry the fallen market sign.
entries.zh: 一位路人帮我们搬起了倒下的集市招牌。

entries.en: Weeks of pent-up excitement erupted when the curtains opened.
entries.zh: 帷幕拉开时，积压数周的兴奋爆发了。

entries.en: The news report described a pile-up on the foggy bridge.
entries.zh: 新闻报道描述了雾中桥上的一次多车相撞事故。

entries.meaningZh: 争夺晋级或冠军的附加赛
entries.en: The teams met in a play-off after finishing level on points.
entries.zh: 积分相同后，两队在附加赛中相遇。

entries.en: She refused point-blank to replace the handmade scenery.
entries.zh: 她断然拒绝替换手工制作的布景。

entries.en: The seminar examined public participation in local policy-making.
entries.zh: 研讨课考察了公众参与地方政策制定的情况。

entries.en: A pop-up bookshop occupied the empty bakery for a weekend.
entries.zh: 一家临时书店在空置的面包店里开了一个周末。

entries.en: The team held a post-mortem after the disappointing concert.
entries.zh: 那场令人失望的音乐会后，团队进行了一次复盘。

entries.en: The novel describes a fragile power-sharing agreement between rival councils.
entries.zh: 小说描述了对立议会之间一份脆弱的权力分享协议。

entries.en: Her pre-eminent position in local theater came from years of work.
entries.zh: 她在本地戏剧界首屈一指的地位来自多年耕耘。

entries.en: The chair pre-empted criticism by explaining the decision immediately.
entries.zh: 主席立即解释了决定，预先化解了批评。

entries.en: The archive preserves pre-war photographs of the waterfront.
entries.zh: 档案保存着滨水区战前的照片。

entries.en: The exhibition links ancient designs with present-day furniture.
entries.zh: 展览把古代设计与当今家具联系起来。

entries.en: In the film, a pro-life campaigner debates a supporter of abortion rights.
entries.zh: 影片中，一位反堕胎活动者与一位堕胎权支持者辩论。

entries.en: The purpose-built studio had unusually good light for painting.
entries.zh: 专为绘画建造的工作室采光格外好。

entries.en: The athlete completed a push-up before joining the relay team.
entries.zh: 那位运动员做了一个俯卧撑，随后加入接力队。

entries.en: She re-entered the hall carrying the missing violin case.
entries.zh: 她带着失而复得的小提琴盒重新走进大厅。

entries.en: The curator re-examined the signature beneath a stronger lamp.
entries.zh: 策展人在更亮的灯下重新检查了签名。

entries.en: We re-ran the simulation after correcting the starting conditions.
entries.zh: 更正初始条件后，我们重新运行了模拟。

entries.en: The ready-made frame was too small for her drawing.
entries.zh: 现成画框对于她的画来说太小了。

entries.en: A red-hot fragment glowed at the center of the furnace.
entries.zh: 炉中央一块烧红的碎片发着光。

entries.en: The right-handed player borrowed a racket from her coach.
entries.zh: 那位惯用右手的球员向教练借了一把球拍。

entries.meaningZh: 收费过高的东西（非正式）
entries.en: The tiny meal felt like a rip-off at that price.
entries.zh: 那么少的一餐卖那个价钱，让人觉得被宰了。

entries.en: The roller-coaster disappeared behind a screen of trees.
entries.zh: 过山车消失在一排树木后方。

entries.en: Without her say-so, the volunteers could not repaint the hall.
entries.zh: 没有她的许可，志愿者不能重新粉刷礼堂。

entries.en: His love of sci-fi began with a radio drama.
entries.zh: 他对科幻作品的热爱始于一部广播剧。

entries.en: Our second-class carriage had wide windows and wooden luggage racks.
entries.zh: 我们的二等车厢有宽窗户和木行李架。

entries.en: The actor refused to dismiss amateur theater as second-rate.
entries.zh: 那位演员不肯把业余戏剧说成二流的。

entries.en: A see-through cover protected the delicate model from dust.
entries.zh: 一个透明罩保护着精巧的模型，防止落灰。

entries.en: She felt self-conscious wearing the enormous hat on stage.
entries.zh: 在台上戴着那顶巨大的帽子，她感到不自在。

entries.en: The cottage had a self-contained studio flat above its garage.
entries.zh: 小屋的车库上方有一间设施齐全、独立使用的单间公寓。

entries.en: It took considerable self-control not to laugh during the ceremony.
entries.zh: 仪式中忍住不笑，需要很强的自制力。

entries.en: The film explores the tension between revenge and self-defence.
entries.zh: 电影探讨了复仇与自卫之间的矛盾。

entries.en: The memoir traces her struggle for self-determination within a strict household.
entries.zh: 回忆录追溯了她在严格家庭中争取自主权的历程。

entries.en: The self-employed carpenter shared a workshop with two potters.
entries.zh: 那位个体经营的木匠与两位陶艺家共用工坊。

entries.en: The need for more storage seemed self-evident after the delivery.
entries.zh: 货物送到后，增加储物空间的必要性显而易见。

entries.en: The novel imagines a self-governing island beyond the empire's reach.
entries.zh: 小说设想了一座帝国无法控制的自治岛屿。

entries.en: The library's self-help section stood beside the travel guides.
entries.zh: 图书馆的自我改善类书区挨着旅行指南区。

entries.en: The unexpected success challenged his gloomy self-image.
entries.zh: 出乎意料的成功动摇了他消极的自我形象。

entries.en: Her self-imposed deadline left little time for extra illustrations.
entries.zh: 她给自己定下的截止日期让额外插画几乎无暇完成。

entries.en: The committee questioned whether generosity or self-interest motivated the donation.
entries.zh: 委员会质疑捐赠是出于慷慨还是私利。

entries.en: He replaced an afternoon of self-pity with work on the mural.
entries.zh: 他不再整个下午自怨自艾，而是动手画壁画。

entries.en: Admitting the mistake did not diminish her self-respect.
entries.zh: 承认错误并没有损害她的自尊。

entries.en: The self-styled historian confused two centuries in his opening sentence.
entries.zh: 那个自称历史学家的人在开场第一句就混淆了两个世纪。

entries.en: The museum protested the sell-off of the old railway workshops.
entries.zh: 博物馆抗议出售旧铁路工坊。

entries.en: The final concert was a sell-out before rehearsals even began.
entries.zh: 排练尚未开始，最后一场音乐会的门票就已售罄。

entries.en: A shake-up of the committee brought several new volunteers into leadership.
entries.zh: 委员会大幅改组，让几位新志愿者进入了领导层。

entries.en: The final was decided by a penalty shoot-out after extra time.
entries.zh: 加时赛后，决赛以点球决胜负。

entries.en: Their short-lived excitement faded when the missing parcel proved empty.
entries.zh: 发现丢失的包裹是空的后，他们短暂的兴奋消退了。

entries.en: The short-sighted plan ignored the building's future maintenance needs.
entries.zh: 这项目光短浅的计划忽视了建筑将来的维护需求。

entries.en: The young show-off insisted on carrying all the chairs himself.
entries.zh: 那个爱炫耀的年轻人坚持自己搬所有椅子。

entries.en: We photographed the sculpture side-on to reveal its unusual shape.
entries.zh: 我们从侧面拍摄雕塑，展示其独特造型。

entries.meaningZh: 创作并演唱歌曲的歌手
entries.en: The singer-songwriter performed a ballad about her grandmother's village.
entries.zh: 创作歌手演唱了一首关于祖母村庄的民谣。

entries.en: Her single-minded dedication kept the restoration project moving.
entries.zh: 她一心一意的投入推动着修复项目。

entries.en: My elder brother and sister-in-law sent us a handmade quilt.
entries.zh: 哥哥和嫂子寄给我们一床手工拼布被。

entries.en: The small-scale exhibition fitted comfortably inside the village hall.
entries.zh: 这场小型展览在村礼堂里布置得十分宽松。

entries.en: A snow-white tablecloth covered the rough wooden table.
entries.zh: 雪白的桌布盖住了粗糙的木桌。

entries.en: He kept telling us that so-and-so knew a better route.
entries.zh: 他不停地告诉我们，某某人知道更好的路线。

entries.en: The scenery was magnificent, but the acting was only so-so.
entries.zh: 布景很壮观，但表演只是一般。

entries.en: The survey compared neighborhoods with different socio-economic conditions.
entries.zh: 调查比较了社会经济条件不同的街区。

entries.en: Their son-in-law helped their daughter restore the old cottage.
entries.zh: 他们的女婿帮助女儿修复了旧小屋。

entries.en: The sought-after designer still made time for student workshops.
entries.zh: 那位备受追捧的设计师仍抽空举办学生工作坊。

entries.en: A small fishing village stood on the south-eastern shore.
entries.zh: 东南岸有一个小渔村。

entries.en: The television spin-off follows the detective's former assistant.
entries.zh: 这部衍生电视剧讲述了那位侦探前助手的故事。

entries.en: Her prediction about the weather was spot-on.
entries.zh: 她对天气的预测准确无误。

entries.en: The argument ended in a stand-off over rehearsal times.
entries.zh: 争论最终在排练时间问题上陷入僵局。

entries.en: The stand-up comedian borrowed a prop from the front row.
entries.zh: 单口喜剧演员从前排借了一件道具。

entries.en: The state-of-the-art scanner revealed marks invisible in ordinary photographs.
entries.zh: 最先进的扫描仪显示了普通照片中看不见的痕迹。

entries.en: He stir-fried the vegetables while she set out the bowls.
entries.zh: 她摆碗时，他把蔬菜快炒了一下。

entries.en: Her summing-up highlighted the three decisions everyone had agreed upon.
entries.zh: 她的总结强调了大家一致同意的三个决定。

entries.en: The tailor-made jacket fitted perfectly over his stage costume.
entries.zh: 那件量身定做的夹克套在他的戏服外正合适。

entries.en: The historical catalogue advertised certain goods as tax-free.
entries.zh: 那本历史商品目录把某些货品宣传为免税商品。

entries.en: The think-tank published a report about urban green spaces.
entries.zh: 智库发表了一份关于城市绿地的报告。

entries.en: Her jacket had three-quarter sleeves and large wooden buttons.
entries.zh: 她的夹克有七分袖和大木纽扣。

entries.en: The throw-in reached a teammate near the halfway line.
entries.zh: 界外球掷给了中线附近的一位队友。

entries.en: An anonymous tip-off helped the detective locate the missing portrait.
entries.zh: 一条匿名密报帮助侦探找到了失踪的肖像画。

entries.en: The amateur orchestra delivered a top-class performance in the tiny hall.
entries.zh: 业余乐团在小礼堂奉献了一场一流的演出。

entries.en: Top-level discussions continued while the volunteers prepared the room.
entries.zh: 志愿者布置房间时，最高级别的讨论仍在继续。

entries.en: He offered everyone a top-up before clearing the teapot.
entries.zh: 收走茶壶前，他问大家是否要续杯。

entries.en: The design involved a trade-off between lightness and strength.
entries.zh: 这项设计需要在轻便与坚固之间作出权衡。

entries.en: The display includes a two-edged sword with a decorated handle.
entries.zh: 展品中有一把剑柄带装饰的双刃剑。

entries.en: Her two-piece suit matched the theater's deep green curtains.
entries.zh: 她的两件套西装与剧院深绿色的帷幕很相配。

entries.en: The workshop encouraged a two-way exchange between artists and visitors.
entries.zh: 工作坊鼓励艺术家与访客之间的双向交流。

entries.en: The under-secretary addressed the committee before the minister arrived.
entries.zh: 部长到来前，次长向委员会作了发言。

entries.en: The festival featured several up-and-coming designers from nearby colleges.
entries.zh: 这个节庆展出了附近高校几位新秀设计师的作品。

entries.en: The user-friendly display let visitors explore the archive themselves.
entries.zh: 易于使用的展示系统让访客能自行浏览档案。

entries.en: The vice-chancellor welcomed new students at the opening ceremony.
entries.zh: 校长在开学典礼上欢迎新生。

entries.en: Her first stage role was a walk-on in a historical drama.
entries.zh: 她第一次登台是在一部历史剧里跑龙套。

entries.en: They rented a third-floor walk-up above a bakery.
entries.zh: 他们在面包店楼上租了一套位于三楼、没有电梯的公寓。

entries.en: The choir's warm-up filled the empty corridor with humming.
entries.zh: 合唱团热身时的哼唱声传遍空走廊。

entries.en: A mountain of washing-up waited beside the tiny sink.
entries.zh: 一大堆待洗餐具堆在小水槽旁。

entries.en: The watered-down proposal satisfied neither the artists nor the committee.
entries.zh: 削弱后的提案既未让艺术家满意，也未让委员会满意。

entries.en: The well-balanced composition draws attention to the central doorway.
entries.zh: 均衡的构图把视线引向中央门口。

entries.en: Each volunteer had a well-defined role during the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览期间，每位志愿者都有明确的职责。

entries.en: A well-dressed stranger asked where the rehearsal was taking place.
entries.zh: 一位衣着得体的陌生人询问排练地点。

entries.en: Her well-meaning suggestion accidentally doubled our preparation work.
entries.zh: 她出于好意的建议却意外让准备工作翻了倍。

entries.en: The novel contrasts two well-off families with very different values.
entries.zh: 小说对比了两个经济宽裕但价值观迥异的家庭。

entries.en: He left a well-paid office job to restore old boats.
entries.zh: 他离开了报酬优厚的办公室工作，转而修复旧船。

entries.en: The well-to-do collector opened her garden for the charity event.
entries.zh: 富裕的收藏家开放了自家花园，举办慈善活动。

entries.en: The survey included white-collar workers from several local offices.
entries.zh: 调查涵盖了当地几家办公室的白领员工。

entries.en: The wide-eyed children watched the giant puppet unfold.
entries.zh: 孩子们惊讶得睁大眼睛，看着巨型木偶展开。

entries.en: The wide-ranging discussion moved from poetry to railway design.
entries.zh: 这场内容广泛的讨论从诗歌谈到了铁路设计。

entries.en: The wind-up bird hopped across the table without batteries.
entries.zh: 那只发条小鸟不用电池，就能在桌上蹦跳。

entries.en: The tiny hall hosted a world-class pianist on Saturday.
entries.zh: 星期六，小礼堂迎来了一位世界一流的钢琴家。

entries.en: The world-famous painting looked smaller than we had imagined.
entries.zh: 那幅举世闻名的画比我们想象的要小。

entries.en: The workshop brought together would-be playwrights from neighboring towns.
entries.zh: 工作坊汇集了邻近城镇有志成为剧作家的人。

entries.en: The old delivery van was a write-off after the collision.
entries.zh: 碰撞之后，那辆旧送货车报废了。

entries.en: Her year-long project ended with an exhibition of portraits.
entries.zh: 她为期一年的项目以一场肖像展结束。

entries.en: The island's year-round ferry service connects it to the mainland.
entries.zh: 岛上全年运营的轮渡把岛屿与大陆连在一起。

entries.en: His yo-yo returned to his hand after a perfect loop.
entries.zh: 悠悠球划出一个漂亮的圈后，回到了他手中。

entries.en: We couldn't find a frame wide enough for the panorama.
entries.zh: 我们找不到足够宽、能装下这幅全景画的画框。

entries.en: An unexpected visitor brought photographs from our village.
entries.zh: 一位意外来访者带来了我们村里的照片。

entries.en: "Yeah, the rehearsal went much better today," she replied.
entries.zh: “是的，今天排练顺利多了，”她回答。

entries.en: "Erm, could you tell me where the rehearsal is?" she asked.
entries.zh: “呃，您能告诉我在哪儿排练吗？”她问。

entries.en: He asked where the john was before the show began.
entries.zh: 演出开始前，他问厕所在哪里。

entries.en: The calculator displayed cos 0 as 1.
entries.zh: 计算器显示零的余弦为一。

entries.en: David folded the map along its faded original creases.
entries.zh: 戴维沿着原先褪色的折痕折起了地图。

entries.en: The postcard cost 40p at the station shop.
entries.zh: 车站商店的那张明信片售价四十便士。

entries.en: The fog quickly hid the path we had just crossed.
entries.zh: 大雾很快遮住了我们刚走过的小路。

entries.en: The organisation repairs donated bicycles for local families.
entries.zh: 这个组织为当地家庭修理捐赠的自行车。

entries.en: The last photograph in the album belongs to Paul.
entries.zh: 相册里的最后一张照片属于保罗。

entries.en: Even George, usually so quiet, joined the final chorus.
entries.zh: 连平常很安静的乔治也加入了最后的合唱。

entries.en: We saved Richard a seat beside the open window.
entries.zh: 我们给理查德在敞开的窗边留了个座位。

entries.en: "Ah, now I see why the model won't balance," she said.
entries.zh: “啊，现在我明白模型为什么不平衡了，”她说。

entries.en: A note from Michael explained the strange blue marks.
entries.zh: 迈克尔留下的便条解释了那些奇怪的蓝色痕迹。

entries.en: The actors rehearsed Act II while the orchestra took a break.
entries.zh: 乐团休息时，演员们排练了第二幕。

entries.en: The smith shaped a small hinge for the wooden gate.
entries.zh: 金属工匠为木门制作了一个小铰链。

entries.en: The winning sketch was William's drawing of an abandoned station.
entries.zh: 获奖的素描是威廉画的一座废弃车站。

entries.en: Only Henry noticed that the painted clock had no hands.
entries.zh: 只有亨利注意到画中的钟没有指针。

entries.en: She carefully separated the damaged pages from the damp cover.
entries.zh: 她小心地把受损书页与潮湿的封皮分开。

entries.en: Mary's unexpected laugh broke the awkward silence.
entries.zh: 玛丽突如其来的笑声打破了尴尬的沉默。

entries.meaningZh: 例如（拉丁语exempli gratia的缩写）
entries.en: We need simple materials, eg cardboard, string and glue.
entries.zh: 我们需要简单的材料，例如纸板、绳子和胶水。

entries.en: The conductor asked Edward to turn the final page.
entries.zh: 指挥请爱德华翻到最后一页。
